title: Information Structure, Parameters & Classification

scope.purpose: Define the semantic structure of information within TIVERIT BIM deliverables: project information baselines, parameter and shared-parameter strategy, classification systems, and asset/lifecycle data expectations.

requirements.statement: BIM models shall function as reliable information containers, not only visual representations.
Project information shall be consistent across all models, centrally defined, and maintained deliberately.
Project Info shall be treated as foundational context for downstream information use rather than optional metadata.
Shared parameters shall be centrally defined, version-controlled, and applied consistently.
Parameters shall be intentional, documented, and aligned with information requirements.
Uncontrolled creation of parameters shall not be permitted.
Classification shall be applied consistently, aligned with agreed standards, and maintained across relevant models.
Asset data shall be purpose-driven and aligned to declared lifecycle needs rather than exhaustive by default.
Lifecycle data shall be structured, complete for declared use, and traceable to its source.
Information shall remain consistent across disciplines, aligned across federated models, and resilient to model separation.
Information structure shall support updates without semantic drift, re-use across phases, auditability, and verification.
BIM deliverables shall carry reliable semantic meaning beyond geometry.
New parameters shall follow governed change processes and be communicated.
Classification supports interpretation and automation but does not replace design intent.
Data without a declared lifecycle purpose shall not be collected as governed lifecycle information.
Data integrity shall be maintained through governed change and verification cycles.

information_demand_boundary: S8 structures and carries information demand governed by S2; it does not redefine the requirement, timing, or permitted use locally.

provenance.migration_note: Primary machine-readable L4 S8 source. Human-readable narrative counterpart: page 2785403. GAP-S8-02 classification registry/protocol structural implementation migrated through classification system/code-set and mapping/carrier field registries plus conformance checks; no specific external classification system is made mandatory by this change.
